metadata.description: Radius environment name for the Azure-backed Kubernetes deployment slice.
Kubernetes namespace used by the Radius-managed Azure slice across AKS, Arc-enabled / Azure Local, or self-managed clusters.
Azure resource group scope used by the Radius Azure provider and recipes.
Azure location for backing resources created by recipes.
Microsoft Entra client ID Dapr components should use for Azure-backed services.
Microsoft Entra object ID that recipes should grant data-plane RBAC for Dapr runtime access.
Microsoft Entra tenant ID Dapr components should use for Azure-backed services.
Principal type for the Microsoft Entra identity used by Dapr runtime access.
OCI registry prefix that stores published Radius recipe artifacts for this repo.
OCI tag used when resolving published Radius recipe artifacts.

variables.stateStoreRecipeParameters: [union(createObject('location', parameters('location')), if(empty(parameters('daprAzureClientId')), createObject(), createObject('azureClientId', parameters('daprAzureClientId'))), if(empty(parameters('daprAzurePrincipalId')), createObject(), createObject('azurePrincipalId', parameters('daprAzurePrincipalId'))), if(empty(parameters('daprAzureTenantId')), createObject(), createObject('azureTenantId', parameters('daprAzureTenantId'))), if(or(empty(parameters('daprAzurePrincipalId')), empty(parameters('daprAzurePrincipalType'))), createObject(), createObject('azurePrincipalType', parameters('daprAzurePrincipalType'))))]

value.name: [reference('env').name]
value.portabilityNote: Radius remains the service wiring authority across AKS, Arc-enabled Kubernetes / Azure Local, and self-managed Kubernetes clusters; Azure-specific work stays in recipes and provider scope.
value.azureSpecificityNote: Backing services in this environment still come from Azure Blob Storage, Service Bus, and Key Vault recipes; the statestore path is designed for Microsoft Entra/RBAC instead of shared keys.
